summary: Join our Oracle RAC Training Course to unlock the power of Real Application Clusters. Elevate your database management skills for better performance.
lede: Real Application Cluster (RAC) training covers configuring and administering clustered databases for availability and scalability. It is for database administrators, IT managers, system architects and other professionals working with database infrastructure, with practical topics including cluster installation, instance and service management, connection load balancing, performance monitoring, backup and recovery, and diagnosing node or interconnect issues.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals looking to enhance their database management capabilities:
modules: RAC in Cloud and Hybrid Environments
Security and Compliance in RAC Systems
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
